name: recruitflow-ai
description: RecruitFlow AI — intelligent recruitment & applicant tracking platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev -w @recruitflow/api" "npm run dev -w @recruitflow/web"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run db:local -w @recruitflow/api" "npm run dev -w @recruitflow/api" "npm run dev -w @recruitflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @recruitflow/api && npm run build -w @recruitflow/web
